'''G'klarg''' was a [[rakghoul]] supersoldier that was created by the mad [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Lorrick hired a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Melarra]] to unknowingly ferry G'klarg, along with [[Chak'aghakh]] and [[Lk'graagth]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]]. The trio burst out of the cargo hold of Melarra's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] upon landing at the [[Kaon City Spaceport]], [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|spreading]] the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] to Kaon. The trio were eventually [[Death/Legends|slain]] during efforts to contain the plague.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G'klarg is one of the three rakghoul supersoliders, the final boss in the Flashpoint "Kaon Under Siege" that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1.<ref name="TOR" />
